articles.title_en: Two experiments on trading information goods in a network
articles.title_cn: 关于网络中信息商品交易的两个实验
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of a cycle path on the trading of a copyable information good in a network experimentally. A cycle path in a network allows a buyer to become a reseller who can compete against existing sellers by replicating the good. A theoretical prediction considers that the price of the information good, even with the first transaction where there is not yet a reseller competing with the original seller, will be lower in networks with a cycle path than otherwise. However, our experiment reveals that the observed price for the first transaction is significantly higher in networks with a cycle path. An additional experiment that enhances competition also does not support the theoretical prediction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验检验了网络中循环路径对可复制信息商品交易的影响。网络中的循环路径允许买方成为转售商，通过复制商品与现有卖方竞争。理论预测认为，即使在首次交易中尚无转售商与原卖方竞争的情况下，具有循环路径的网络中的信息商品价格也会低于其他情况。然而，我们的实验表明，在具有循环路径的网络中，首次交易的观察价格显著更高。一个增强竞争的额外实验也不支持理论预测。

articles.title_en: An undecidable statement regarding zero-sum games
articles.title_cn: 关于零和博弈的一个不可判定命题
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we give an example of a statement concerning two-player zero-sum games which is undecidable, meaning that it can neither be proven or disproven by the standard axioms of mathematics. Earlier work has shown that there exist “paradoxical” two-player zero-sum games with unbounded payoffs, in which a standard calculation of the two players' expected utilities of a mixed strategy profile yield a positive sum. We show that whether or not a modified version of this paradoxical situation, with bounded payoffs and a weaker measurability requirement, exists is an unanswerable question. Our proof relies on a mixture of techniques from set theory and ergodic theory.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们给出了一个关于两人零和博弈的命题的例子，该命题是不可判定的，意味着它既不能被数学的标准公理证明也不能被反驳。早期的工作表明，存在具有无界收益的“悖论性”两人零和博弈，在这些博弈中，对混合策略组合的两位玩家期望效用的标准计算产生正和。我们证明了这种悖论情形的一个修改版本（具有有界收益和较弱的可测性要求）是否存在是一个无法回答的问题。我们的证明依赖于集合论和遍历论技术的混合。

articles.title_en: Simple relational contracts and the dynamics of social capital
articles.title_cn: 简单关系契约与社会资本的动态
articles.abstract_en: This article proposes a dynamic model to examine the structure of “simple” relational contracts, obeying realistic properties that can be easily understood and audited by both parties. In such relationships, the need to offer each supplier a large enough share of future business to deter cheating limits the number of relationships a buyer can sustain. Trade is thus restricted to durable relationships, a form of social capital. Nevertheless, exogenous stochastic shocks sometimes prevent suppliers from fulfilling their promises and relationships are constantly dissolving and later renewed. Moreover, the coming of a crisis, where stochastic shocks are more probable, can lead to the quick rupture of some relationships as there is less expected future business to incentivize all suppliers. New relationships can later be formed, but this takes time due to search frictions. This suggests new connections between the theory of relational contracting and the macroeconomic analysis of recessions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个动态模型，以考察“简单”关系契约的结构，这些契约遵循双方易于理解和审计的现实属性。在这种关系中，需要向每个供应商提供足够大的未来业务份额以防止欺骗，这限制了买方能够维持的关系数量。因此，贸易仅限于持久的关系，这是一种社会资本形式。然而，外生随机冲击有时会阻止供应商履行其承诺，关系不断解体并随后更新。此外，危机的到来，即随机冲击更可能发生的时候，可能导致某些关系迅速破裂，因为预期未来业务减少，无法激励所有供应商。新关系可以随后形成，但由于搜索摩擦，这需要时间。这表明关系契约理论与宏观经济衰退分析之间存在新的联系。

articles.title_en: Optimal auction design with aftermarket Cournot competition
articles.title_cn: 具有售后古诺竞争的最优拍卖设计
articles.abstract_en: We study an optimal information/mechanism design problem for selling an object to a number of asymmetric, privately informed bidders in which the winning bidder competes with a third party under differentiated Cournot competition afterwards. We show how to decompose the problem into two sub-problems: Bayesian persuasion and standard mechanism design. Full disclosure of the winner's marginal cost emerges as the unique optimal information policy, combined with allocating the auctioned object to the bidder with the highest “virtual surplus.” Bidders' signaling incentives increase the seller's expected revenue and lower discriminatory reserve prices in the optimal mechanism, improving ex post efficiency, measured by the probability of no-sale.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个向多个不对称、拥有私人信息的竞拍者出售物品的最优信息/机制设计问题，其中获胜竞拍者随后在差异化古诺竞争下与第三方竞争。我们展示了如何将问题分解为两个子问题：贝叶斯说服和标准机制设计。完全披露获胜者的边际成本成为唯一的最优信息政策，并结合将拍卖物品分配给具有最高“虚拟剩余”的竞拍者。竞拍者的信号激励提高了卖方的预期收入，并在最优机制中降低了歧视性保留价格，从而提高了事后效率，以无销售的概率衡量。

articles.title_en: Efficiency wages with motivated agents
articles.title_cn: 激励型代理人的效率工资
articles.abstract_en: Many jobs serve a social purpose beyond profit maximization, contributing positively to society. This paper uses a modified principal-agent gift-exchange game with positive externality (prosocial treatment) to study how workers' prosocial motivation interacts with the use of efficiency wages in stimulating effort. We find that prosocial motivation and efficiency wages are independent in stimulating effort: compared to a standard gift-exchange game (GE treatment), the presence of the externality shifts the agents' effort choice function upwards without affecting its slope. Thus, if principals were profit-maximizers, wage offers should be the same in both treatments. However, principals offer higher wages in the prosocial treatment. We show that this is due to principals in the GE treatment highly underestimating agents' reciprocity and thereby offering wages below the profit-maximizing level. Results from robustness-checks further suggest that our findings are unlikely to be driven by a simple efficiency effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多工作除了追求利润最大化外，还服务于社会目的，对社会产生积极贡献。本文采用一个带有正外部性（亲社会处理）的修正委托-代理礼物交换博弈，研究工人的亲社会动机如何与效率工资在激励努力方面相互作用。我们发现，亲社会动机和效率工资在激励努力方面是独立的：与标准礼物交换博弈（GE处理）相比，外部性的存在使代理人的努力选择函数上移，但不影响其斜率。因此，如果委托人是利润最大化者，两种处理下的工资报价应该相同。然而，委托人在亲社会处理中提供更高的工资。我们表明，这是因为在GE处理中，委托人严重低估了代理人的互惠性，从而提供的工资低于利润最大化水平。稳健性检验的结果进一步表明，我们的发现不太可能由简单的效率效应驱动。

articles.title_en: Equilibrium information in credence goods
articles.title_cn: 信任品中的均衡信息
articles.abstract_en: We study credence goods in a general model. A consumer may suffer a loss which is a continuous random variable. Privately observing the loss value, an expert can provide a repair at a price to eliminate the consumer's loss. All perfect-Bayesian equilibria are inefficient, in that some losses are not repaired. In closed form, we derive a pooling equilibrium (where losses are inferred to be in an interval), and a separating equilibrium (where losses are precisely inferred). If the expert can acquire an information structure on losses, the first best is achieved by a binary signal. Results are robust when cost and loss are random and correlated, and when there are multiple experts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个一般模型中研究信任品。消费者可能遭受一个连续随机变量的损失。专家私下观察损失值后，可以以一定价格提供维修以消除消费者的损失。所有完美贝叶斯均衡都是无效率的，因为某些损失未被修复。我们以闭式解推导出一个混同均衡（其中损失被推断为处于一个区间内）和一个分离均衡（其中损失被精确推断）。如果专家能够获取关于损失的信息结构，则通过二元信号可以实现最优结果。当成本与损失随机且相关，以及存在多个专家时，结果具有稳健性。

articles.title_en: Bayesian stable states
articles.title_cn: 贝叶斯稳定状态
articles.abstract_en: This paper extends the Bayesian stability notion of Liu (2020) to define the Bayesian stability of a market state, which consists of a matching outcome and an information structure. The information structure can be arbitrarily heterogeneous and can accommodate learning among agents. We first establish that a Bayesian stable matching function of Liu (2020) can be recast as Bayesian stable market states with homogeneous information. We then illustrate the usefulness of such an extension by (i) refining Liu's Bayesian efficiency notion to define the Bayesian efficiency of a market state and (ii) generalizing his result—that Bayesian stable matching functions are Bayesian efficient—to an analogous one for market states. More importantly, we show that (iii) a decentralized matching process converges to a Bayesian stable market state and thereby offer a decentralized foundation for Liu's Bayesian stable matching function.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文扩展了Liu（2020）的贝叶斯稳定性概念，以定义市场状态的贝叶斯稳定性，该状态由匹配结果和信息结构组成。信息结构可以是任意异质的，并能容纳主体间的学习。我们首先证明，Liu（2020）的贝叶斯稳定匹配函数可以重新表述为具有同质信息的贝叶斯稳定市场状态。然后，我们通过（i）细化Liu的贝叶斯效率概念以定义市场状态的贝叶斯效率，以及（ii）将他的结果——贝叶斯稳定匹配函数是贝叶斯有效的——推广到市场状态的类似结果，来说明这种扩展的有用性。更重要的是，我们表明（iii）一个分散的匹配过程收敛于贝叶斯稳定市场状态，从而为Liu的贝叶斯稳定匹配函数提供了分散化基础。

articles.title_en: Hidden in plain sight: Payoffs, probability, space, and time in isomorphic tasks
articles.title_cn: 显而易见：同构任务中的收益、概率、空间与时间
articles.abstract_en: Highest stoppage games in economics—first price sealed bid auction and Dutch auction, among others—have produced striking puzzles, including violation of revenue equivalence between auctions and adjustment of behavior across interfaces. The latter is also observed in risk elicitation. Here, we use existing puzzles to shed light on each other, by nesting auction and risk tasks in a common environment. We find behavior consistent with a spatial interface imparting the same relevant auction-theoretic surplus and probability information as does an interactive numerical calculation tool. Empirical revenue equivalence (respectively, risky choice) can thus be altered by design.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学中的最高停止博弈——包括第一价格密封拍卖和荷兰式拍卖等——产生了引人注目的谜题，包括拍卖之间收益等价性的违背以及跨界面行为的调整。后者在风险诱导中也被观察到。在此，我们通过将拍卖和风险任务嵌套在一个共同环境中，利用现有谜题相互阐明。我们发现行为与空间界面传递相同的相关拍卖理论剩余和概率信息，如同交互式数值计算工具一样。因此，经验收益等价性（分别地，风险选择）可以通过设计来改变。

articles.title_en: On common evaluation standards and the acceptance of wage inequality
articles.title_cn: 关于共同评价标准与工资不平等接受度
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates how the exogenous provision of norm information concerning wage inequality influences the acceptance of wage differences. In an experiment where one employer interacts with two employees who differ in productivities, two main treatments provide information suggesting either an injunctive norm for small or for large wage differences prior to the interaction.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了关于工资不平等的外生规范信息如何影响对工资差异的接受度。在一项实验中，一位雇主与两位生产率不同的员工互动，两个主要处理组在互动前提供信息，分别暗示小工资差异或大工资差异的禁令性规范。

articles.title_en: Entry under placement uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 配额不确定性下的企业进入
articles.abstract_en: We present a model of firm entry in an industry that operates under an aggregate production quota or cap-and-trade (CAT) regulation. Firms are heterogeneous in their own productivity; each knows its costs of production but is uncertain about where its costs rank among an entrant population. We show the existence of a unique, symmetric, dominance solvable, Bayesian Nash equilibrium in switching strategies in a parameterized game with a continuum of players. Our main result is that uncertainty over one's productivity rank is sufficient to cause socially inefficient over-entry when the average cost in the population of potential entrants is low. We find socially inefficient under-entry when the opposite conditions hold. Within both the class of models on global games with strategic substitutes and the class of models on firm entry, our model offers innovative insights into inefficient over-entry, under-entry, and introduces a novel underlying mechanism that drives entry bias.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个在总量生产配额或总量控制与交易（CAT）监管下运营的行业中的企业进入模型。企业在其自身生产率方面存在异质性；每家企业都知道其生产成本，但不确定其成本在进入者群体中的排名。我们证明，在一个具有连续参与者的参数化博弈中，存在一个唯一的、对称的、可支配求解的贝叶斯纳什均衡，采用切换策略。我们的主要结果是，当潜在进入者群体的平均成本较低时，对自身生产率排名的不确定性足以导致社会效率低下的过度进入。当相反条件成立时，我们发现社会效率低下的进入不足。在具有战略替代品的全局博弈模型类别和企业进入模型类别中，我们的模型为低效过度进入、进入不足提供了创新性见解，并引入了一种驱动进入偏差的新颖潜在机制。

articles.title_en: Efficient matching under general constraints
articles.title_cn: 一般约束下的有效匹配
articles.abstract_en: We study indivisible goods allocation problems under constraints and provide algorithms to check whether a given matching is Pareto efficient. We first show that the serial dictatorship algorithm can be used to check Pareto efficiency if the constraints are matroid. To prove this, we develop a generalized top trading cycles algorithm. Moreover, we show that the matroid structure is necessary for obtaining all Pareto efficient matchings by the serial dictatorship algorithm. Second, we provide an extension of the serial dictatorship algorithm to check Pareto efficiency under general constraints. As an application of our results to prioritized allocations, we discuss Pareto improving the deferred acceptance algorithm.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究约束条件下的不可分割商品分配问题，并提供算法来检查给定匹配是否为帕累托有效。我们首先表明，如果约束是拟阵，则串行独裁算法可用于检查帕累托效率。为了证明这一点，我们开发了一种广义的顶级交易周期算法。此外，我们表明，拟阵结构对于通过串行独裁算法获得所有帕累托有效匹配是必要的。其次，我们提供了串行独裁算法的扩展，以检查一般约束下的帕累托效率。作为我们的结果在优先分配中的应用，我们讨论了帕累托改进延迟接受算法。

articles.title_en: Voting to persuade
articles.title_cn: 投票以说服
articles.abstract_en: We consider a model of collective persuasion, in which members of an advisory committee with private continuous signals vote on a policy change. A decision maker then decides whether to adopt the change upon observing each vote. Information transmission between the committee and the decision maker is possible if and only if there exists an informative equilibrium in which the decision maker only adopts the policy change after a unanimous vote. Similarly, full information aggregation is achievable if and only if such an equilibrium exists when the size of the committee is large enough. We further discuss why our continuous-signal model produces results different from discrete-signal models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个集体说服模型，其中拥有私人连续信号的咨询委员会成员就政策变更进行投票。决策者在观察到每次投票后决定是否采纳该变更。当且仅当存在一个信息性均衡，使得决策者仅在全体一致投票后才采纳政策变更时，委员会与决策者之间的信息传递才是可能的。类似地，当委员会规模足够大时，当且仅当这样的均衡存在，完全信息聚合才是可实现的。我们进一步讨论了为什么我们的连续信号模型产生的结果与离散信号模型不同。

articles.title_en: Strong core and Pareto-optimality in the multiple partners matching problem under lexicographic preference domains
articles.title_cn: 字典序偏好域下多伙伴匹配问题中的强核与帕累托最优性
articles.abstract_en: We study strong core and Pareto-optimal solutions for multiple partners matching problem under lexicographic preference domains from a computational point of view. The restriction to the two-sided case is called stable many-to-many matching problem and the general one-sided case is called stable fixtures problem. We provide an example to show that the strong core can be empty even for many-to-many problems, and that deciding the non-emptiness of the strong core is NP-hard. On the positive side, we give efficient algorithms for finding a near feasible strong core solution and for finding a fractional matching in the strong core of fractional matchings. In contrast with the NP-hardness result for the stable fixtures problem, we show that finding a maximum size matching that is Pareto-optimal can be done efficiently for many-to-many problems. Finally, we show that for reverse-lexicographic preferences the strong core is always non-empty in the many-to-many case.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从计算角度研究了字典序偏好域下多伙伴匹配问题中的强核与帕累托最优解。限制为双边情形时称为稳定多对多匹配问题，一般单边情形称为稳定赛程问题。我们给出一个例子表明，即使对于多对多问题，强核也可能为空，并且判定强核非空性是NP难的。在积极方面，我们给出了寻找近似可行强核解以及寻找分数匹配强核中分数匹配的有效算法。与稳定赛程问题的NP难结果相反，我们表明对于多对多问题，寻找最大规模且帕累托最优的匹配可以高效完成。最后，我们表明对于逆字典序偏好，在多对多情形下强核总是非空的。

articles.title_en: Best-response dynamics in two-person random games with correlated payoffs
articles.title_cn: 相关支付下两人随机博弈中的最优反应动态
articles.abstract_en: We consider finite two-player normal form games with random payoffs. Player A's payoffs are i.i.d. from a uniform distribution. Given p∈[0,1], for any action profile, player B's payoff coincides with player A's payoff with probability p and is i.i.d. from the same uniform distribution with probability 1−p. This model interpolates the model of i.i.d. random payoff used in most of the literature and the model of random potential games. First we study the number of pure Nash equilibria in the above class of games. Then we show that, for any positive p, asymptotically in the number of available actions, best response dynamics reaches a pure Nash equilibrium with high probability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有随机支付的有限两人标准式博弈。参与者A的支付独立同分布，服从均匀分布。给定p∈[0,1]，对于任何行动组合，参与者B的支付以概率p与参与者A的支付相同，并以概率1−p独立同分布地来自同一均匀分布。该模型插值了大多数文献中使用的独立同分布随机支付模型与随机势博弈模型。首先，我们研究上述博弈类别中纯纳什均衡的数量。然后，我们证明，对于任何正p，在可用行动数量渐近意义上，最优反应动态以高概率达到纯纳什均衡。

articles.title_en: Collusion-proof mechanisms for full surplus extraction
articles.title_cn: 防共谋的完全剩余提取机制
articles.abstract_en: The paper examines information structures that can guarantee full surplus extraction via collusion-proof mechanisms. Our collusion-proofness notion requires that there does not exist any coalition whose manipulation can affect the mechanism designer's payoff. When the mechanism designer is restricted to using standard Bayesian mechanisms, we show that under almost every prior distribution of agents' types, there exist payoff structures under which there is no collusion-proof full surplus extracting mechanism. However, when ambiguous mechanisms are allowed, we provide a weak necessary and sufficient condition on the prior such that collusion-proof full surplus extraction can be guaranteed. Thus, the paper sheds light on how the collusion-proofness requirement resolves the full surplus extraction paradox of Crémer and McLean (1985, 1988) and how engineering ambiguity in mechanism rules restores the paradox.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了能够通过防共谋机制保证完全剩余提取的信息结构。我们的防共谋概念要求不存在任何联盟，其操纵能够影响机制设计者的收益。当机制设计者被限制使用标准贝叶斯机制时，我们表明，在几乎所有的代理人类型先验分布下，都存在收益结构使得不存在防共谋的完全剩余提取机制。然而，当允许模糊机制时，我们提供了关于先验的一个弱充分必要条件，使得防共谋的完全剩余提取能够得到保证。因此，本文揭示了防共谋要求如何解决Crémer和McLean（1985，1988）的完全剩余提取悖论，以及如何在机制规则中设计模糊性来恢复这一悖论。

articles.title_en: Relative performance evaluation in spillover networks
articles.title_cn: 溢出网络中的相对绩效评估
articles.abstract_en: In a multi-agent contracting problem, agents are linked in performance through two channels, effort spillover, governed by spillover network, and risk correlation, governed by risk structure. Assigning compensation weights on peers' performances can not only filter out common risks but also alter agent's incentives. We study how the network and risk structure jointly determine the optimal linear contract. First, the relative compensation sensitivity is determined by ratio of the dot product, between spillover vector and pure hedge portfolio, to unhedgeable risk. We then propose an index named informativeness along the spillover direction and argue that this index measures how precisely the principal can infer the agent's effort. By showing that both the implemented effort and induced welfare are increasing in the informativeness index, we argue that this index captures how central each agent is in this economy. Finally, results regarding relative sensitivities still hold under optimal contract with bounded compensation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在多代理契约问题中，代理人的绩效通过两个渠道相互关联：由溢出网络决定的努力溢出，以及由风险结构决定的风险相关性。对同伴绩效赋予薪酬权重不仅可以过滤共同风险，还可以改变代理人的激励。我们研究网络和风险结构如何共同决定最优线性契约。首先，相对薪酬敏感性由溢出向量与纯对冲投资组合的点积与不可对冲风险的比率决定。然后，我们提出了一个名为沿溢出方向的信息量的指标，并认为该指标衡量了委托人推断代理人努力的精确程度。通过证明实施的努力和引致的福利都随信息量指标增加而增加，我们认为该指标捕捉了每个代理人在该经济中的中心性。最后，在有界薪酬的最优契约下，关于相对敏感性的结果仍然成立。

articles.title_en: Experimental evidence on the relationship between perceived ambiguity and likelihood insensitivity
articles.title_cn: 关于感知模糊性与似然不敏感性之间关系的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Observed individual behavior in the presence of ambiguity shows insufficient responsiveness to changes in subjective likelihoods. Despite being integral to theoretical models and relevant in many domains, evidence on the causes and determining factors of such likelihood insensitive behavior is scarce. This paper investigates the role of beliefs in the form of ambiguity perception – the extent to which a decision-maker has difficulties assigning a single probability to each possible event – as a potential determinant. Using an experiment, I elicit measures of ambiguity perception and likelihood insensitivity and exogenously vary the level of perceived ambiguity. The results provide strong support for a perception-based explanation of likelihood insensitivity. The two measures are highly correlated at the individual level, and exogenously increasing ambiguity perception increases insensitivity, suggesting a causal relationship. In contrast, ambiguity perception is unrelated to ambiguity aversion – the extent to which a decision-maker dislikes the presence of ambiguity.
articles.abstract_cn: 在存在模糊性的情况下，观察到的个体行为显示出对主观似然变化的响应不足。尽管这在理论模型中不可或缺，并在许多领域中具有相关性，但关于这种似然不敏感行为的原因和决定因素的证据却很少。本文研究了信念在模糊性感知形式中的作用——即决策者在为每个可能事件分配单一概率时遇到困难的程度——作为一个潜在的决定因素。通过实验，我引出了模糊性感知和似然不敏感性的度量，并外生地变化感知模糊性的水平。结果强烈支持基于感知的似然不敏感性解释。这两个度量在个体层面上高度相关，并且外生地增加模糊性感知会增加不敏感性，表明存在因果关系。相比之下，模糊性感知与模糊厌恶——即决策者不喜欢模糊性存在的程度——无关。

articles.title_en: Information avoidance in school choice
articles.title_cn: 择校中的信息回避
articles.abstract_en: I explain puzzles in the school assignment literature using a many-to-one matching model in which participants on one side of the market, the students, are endowed with ego-utilities à la Köszegi (2006). Ego concerns generate a form of information avoidance that results in non-truthful participation in DA matching mechanisms. In particular, students' best replies may be non-monotonic in school ranks. I show that truthful reporting can be restored by imposing a limit on the measure of students that a school can deem acceptable. Furthermore, students may be sensitive to signal garbling, in the sense of Blackwell (1953). In terms of policy, the results imply that admission committees' reliance on application dimensions that are seemingly weak proxies of academic performance may be beneficial. Other implications suggest that affirmative action policies might be beneficial. However, when students' best replies exhibit non-monotonicity in schools' selectivity, such policies might backfire.
articles.abstract_cn: 我使用一个多对一匹配模型来解释学校分配文献中的谜题，在该模型中，市场一侧的参与者（即学生）拥有科塞吉（Köszegi，2006）式的自我效用。自我关注产生了一种信息回避形式，导致在DA匹配机制中的非真实参与。特别是，学生的最佳反应可能在学校排名中是非单调的。我表明，通过对学校可认为可接受的学生数量施加限制，可以恢复真实报告。此外，学生可能对信号干扰敏感，这是布莱克韦尔（Blackwell，1953）意义上的。在政策方面，结果表明，招生委员会依赖看似学术表现弱代理的申请维度可能是有益的。其他含义表明，平权行动政策可能是有益的。然而，当学生的最佳反应在学校选择性方面表现出非单调性时，此类政策可能会适得其反。

articles.title_en: Information flows and memory in games
articles.title_cn: 博弈中的信息流与记忆
articles.abstract_en: The standard extensive-form partitional representation of information in sequential games fails to distinguish the description of the rules of interaction from the description of players' personal traits. Indeed, this representation does not model how the information given to players as per the rules of the game blends with players' cognitive abilities. We propose a representation of sequential games that explicitly describes the flow of information accruing to players rather than the stock of information retained by players encoded in information partitions. Then, we add a game-independent description of players' mnemonic abilities. If players have perfect memory, our flow representation gives rise to information partitions satisfying the perfect recall property, but different combinations of information flows and players' mnemonic abilities may induce the same information partitions. We show how to use our framework to explicitly model a wide array of cognitive limitations and embed them in the representation of game situations.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准扩展式博弈中信息的划分表示未能区分互动规则的描述与玩家个人特质的描述。实际上，这种表示并未建模博弈规则赋予玩家的信息如何与玩家的认知能力相结合。我们提出了一种序贯博弈的表示，明确描述了玩家获得的信息流，而非以信息划分编码的玩家所保留的信息存量。然后，我们添加了与博弈无关的玩家记忆能力描述。如果玩家具有完美记忆，我们的信息流表示会产生满足完美回忆性质的信息划分，但不同的信息流与玩家记忆能力的组合可能诱导出相同的信息划分。我们展示了如何使用我们的框架来明确建模广泛的认知限制，并将其嵌入博弈情境的表示中。

articles.title_en: Myopic oligopoly pricing
articles.title_cn: 短视寡头定价
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines capacity-constrained oligopoly pricing with sellers who seek myopic improvements. We employ the Myopic Stable Set solution concept and establish the existence of a unique pure-strategy price solution for any given level of capacity. This solution is shown to coincide with the set of pure-strategy Nash equilibria when capacities are large or small. For an intermediate range of capacities, it predicts a price interval that includes the mixed-strategy support. This stability concept thus encompasses all Nash equilibria and offers a pure-strategy solution when there is none in Nash terms. It particularly provides a behavioral rationale for different pricing patterns, including Edgeworth price cycles and states of hyper-competition with supply shortages. We also analyze the impact of a change in firm size distribution. A merger among the biggest firms may lead to more price dispersion as it increases the maximum and decreases the minimum myopically stable price.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在产能约束下，卖方寻求短视改进的寡头定价问题。我们采用短视稳定集解概念，并证明了对于任何给定的产能水平，存在唯一的纯策略价格解。该解在产能较大或较小时与纯策略纳什均衡集一致。对于中间范围的产能，它预测了一个包含混合策略支撑的价格区间。因此，这一稳定性概念涵盖了所有纳什均衡，并在纳什意义上不存在纯策略解时提供了纯策略解。它特别为不同的定价模式提供了行为学解释，包括埃奇沃斯价格周期和供应短缺的超级竞争状态。我们还分析了企业规模分布变化的影响。最大企业之间的合并可能导致更大的价格离散，因为它提高了最大短视稳定价格并降低了最小短视稳定价格。

articles.title_en: Auction design with heterogeneous priors
articles.title_cn: 异质先验下的拍卖设计
articles.abstract_en: We consider an auction design problem with private values, where the seller and bidders may enjoy heterogeneous priors about their (possibly correlated) valuations. Each bidder forms an (interim) belief about the others based on his own prior updated by observing his own value. If the seller faces uncertainty about the bidders' priors, even if he knows that the bidders' priors are within any given distance from his, he may find it worst-case optimal to propose a dominant-strategy auction mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个具有私人价值的拍卖设计问题，其中卖方和竞买人可能对其（可能相关的）估值持有异质先验。每个竞买人基于自己的先验，在观察到自己的价值后更新，形成关于他人的（中期）信念。如果卖方面临关于竞买人先验的不确定性，即使他知道竞买人的先验与其自身先验在任意给定距离内，他可能发现提出占优策略拍卖机制是极端情况下的最优选择。

articles.title_en: Who's the deceiver? Identifying deceptive intentions in communication
articles.title_cn: 谁是欺骗者？识别沟通中的欺骗意图
articles.abstract_en: Recognizing people's deceptive intentions when communicating is crucial to detect statements that may drive us to unintended harmful decisions. This paper studies individuals' intentions in games where players can tell the truth with deceiving purposes. In a preregistered experiment, we combine a sender-receiver game with possible strategic considerations and the associated belief elicitation questionnaire, with a sender-receiver game with no room for strategic considerations. We propose a new method that improves the identification of senders' intentions to deceive. Our findings reveal that relying solely on the strategic sender-receiver game and the elicited beliefs, as previously proposed in the literature, can lead to misinterpreting the actual intentions of a substantial proportion of senders. In particular, our new method helps discern actual deceivers from pessimistic truth-tellers and identifies senders who try to excuse their previous deceiving message. All in all, our method identifies more senders with deceptive intentions compared to previous methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 识别人们在沟通中的欺骗意图对于检测可能驱使我们做出非预期有害决策的陈述至关重要。本文研究了个体在博弈中的意图，在这些博弈中，玩家可以说真话但带有欺骗目的。在一项预注册实验中，我们将一个具有潜在策略性考虑和伴随信念诱导问卷的发送者-接收者博弈，与一个没有策略性考虑空间的发送者-接收者博弈相结合。我们提出了一种新方法，改进了对发送者欺骗意图的识别。我们的研究结果表明，仅依赖策略性发送者-接收者博弈和诱导出的信念（如先前文献所提出的）可能导致对相当大比例发送者的实际意图产生误解。特别是，我们的新方法有助于区分实际的欺骗者与悲观的诚实者，并识别出试图为其先前欺骗性信息找借口的发送者。总而言之，与先前方法相比，我们的方法识别出更多具有欺骗意图的发送者。

articles.title_en: Contests within and between groups: Theory and experiment
articles.title_cn: 组内与组间竞赛：理论与实验
articles.abstract_en: We examine behavior in a two-stage group contest where intra-group contests are followed by an inter-group contest. Rewards accrue to the winning group, with winners of the intra-group contest within that group receiving a greater reward. The model generates a discouragement effect, where losers from the first stage exert less effort in the second stage than winners. In contrast to the related literature, we show that a prior win may be disadvantageous, generating lower profits for first stage winners as compared to losers. We consider exogenous asymmetry between groups arising from a biased group contest success function. Although the asymmetry occurs in the second stage, its effect plays out in the first stage, with higher intra-group conflict in the advantaged group. Experimental results support the qualitative predictions of the model. However, losers from the first stage bear a higher burden of the group contribution than the theoretical prediction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了一个两阶段群体竞赛中的行为，其中组内竞赛之后是组间竞赛。奖励归属于获胜群体，该群体内组内竞赛的获胜者获得更大的奖励。该模型产生了一种挫败效应，即第一阶段失败者在第二阶段付出的努力少于获胜者。与相关文献相反，我们表明先前的胜利可能是不利的，导致第一阶段获胜者相对于失败者获得更低的利润。我们考虑了由有偏的群体竞赛成功函数引起的群体之间的外生不对称性。尽管这种不对称发生在第二阶段，但其影响在第一阶段就显现出来，优势群体内部的冲突更高。实验结果支持模型的定性预测。然而，第一阶段的失败者承担的群体贡献负担高于理论预测。

articles.title_en: Identity change and economic mobility: Experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 身份转变与经济流动性：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: I study the impact identity change (assimilation) has on economic mobility. I experimentally assign people to different group identities, majority or minority, before they interact in a social coordination setting. In equilibrium, minority assimilators achieve economic mobility by integrating with the majority. In the experiment, assimilators are discriminated against and cannot integrate, if majority members encounter conformists (non-assimilators) in the minority. Thus, assimilators fail to attain economic mobility because those who maintain the status quo impose negative externalities on those who risk changing it.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了身份转变（同化）对经济流动性的影响。我通过实验将人们分配到不同的群体身份，即多数群体或少数群体，然后让他们在社会协调环境中互动。在均衡状态下，少数群体的同化者通过与多数群体融合来实现经济流动性。在实验中，如果多数群体成员在少数群体中遇到墨守成规者（非同化者），同化者会受到歧视且无法融入。因此，同化者未能实现经济流动性，因为那些维持现状的人对敢于改变现状的人施加了负外部性。

articles.title_en: Oddness of the number of Nash equilibria: The case of polynomial payoff functions
articles.title_cn: 纳什均衡数量的奇异性：多项式收益函数的情形
articles.abstract_en: In 1971, Wilson (1971) proved that “almost all” finite games have an odd number of mixed Nash equilibria. Since then, several other proofs have been given, but always for mixed extensions of finite games. In this paper, we present a new oddness theorem for large classes of polynomial payoff functions and semi-algebraic sets of strategies. Additionally, we provide some applications to recent models of games on networks such that Patacchini-Zenou's model about juvenile delinquency and conformism (Patacchini and Zenou, 2012), Calvó-Armengol-Patacchini-Zenou's model about social networks in education (Calvó-Armengol et al., 2009), Konig-Liu-Zenou's model about R&D networks (König et al., 2019), Helsley-Zenou's model about social networks and interactions in cities (Helsley and Zenou, 2014).
articles.abstract_cn: 在1971年，Wilson（1971）证明了“几乎所有”有限博弈都有奇数个混合纳什均衡。此后，给出了若干其他证明，但总是针对有限博弈的混合扩展。在本文中，我们针对大类多项式收益函数和半代数策略集提出了一个新的奇异性定理。此外，我们将其应用于近期网络博弈模型，如Patacchini-Zenou关于青少年犯罪与从众行为的模型（Patacchini和Zenou，2012），Calvó-Armengol-Patacchini-Zenou关于教育中社交网络的模型（Calvó-Armengol等，2009），Konig-Liu-Zenou关于研发网络的模型（König等，2019），以及Helsley-Zenou关于城市中社交网络与互动的模型（Helsley和Zenou，2014）。

articles.title_en: Winner's effort in multi-battle team contests
articles.title_cn: 多战役团队竞赛中获胜者的努力
articles.abstract_en: In multi-battle team contests with pairwise battles, how battles are organized—sequentially or (partially) simultaneously—may affect the expected winner's total effort (WE), a natural objective in R&D races, elections, and sports. We focus on noise (modeled via the contest success function's discriminatory power) and across-team heterogeneity, abstracting from player-specific heterogeneity. With sufficient noise, we show that: (1) If teams are symmetric, all temporal structures yield the same WE; and (2) If teams are asymmetric, WE is maximized by a fully simultaneous contest and minimized by a fully sequential one. With no noise, we show that: (3) If teams are symmetric, WE is maximized by a fully sequential contest and minimized by a fully simultaneous one; and (4) If teams are asymmetric, neither the fully sequential nor the fully simultaneous temporal structures maximize or minimize WE. Our results use a novel technique that simplifies temporal structure comparisons: extractions and mergers.
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有成对战役的多战役团队竞赛中，战役的组织方式——顺序进行或（部分）同时进行——可能影响预期获胜者的总努力（WE），这是研发竞赛、选举和体育中的一个自然目标。我们关注噪声（通过竞赛成功函数的歧视能力建模）和跨团队异质性，抽象掉选手特定异质性。在足够噪声下，我们证明：（1）如果团队对称，所有时间结构产生相同的WE；（2）如果团队不对称，WE由完全同时竞赛最大化，由完全顺序竞赛最小化。在无噪声下，我们证明：（3）如果团队对称，WE由完全顺序竞赛最大化，由完全同时竞赛最小化；（4）如果团队不对称，完全顺序和完全同时的时间结构都不最大化或最小化WE。我们的结果使用了一种简化时间结构比较的新技术：提取和合并。

excluded_items.title_en: Maximal Condorcet domains. A further progress report
